name: record_01
evidence: In the anti-FXII study, the first BLQ after the last quantified observation was replaced by LLOQ/2; other BLQ values were missing. Later anti-uPA/YEY analyses used BLQ as missing and examined a first-BLQ=LLOQ/2 sensitivity analysis.

name: record_02
evidence: Terminal reliability required adjusted R-squared above 0.85, extrapolated AUC below 20%, and a terminal span above 1.5 half-lives. Interleaved anti-IL6 WT cohorts produced a zigzag profile with adjusted R-squared below 0.60, so only nonterminal parameters were reported.

name: record_03
evidence: The studies measured FcRn-antagonist antibody disposition and endogenous-IgG pharmacodynamics as different outcomes.
